translations.web: Yes, all the people of the land will bury them; and they will become famous in the day that I will be glorified,” says the Lord Yahweh.
translations.bsb: All the people of the land will bury them, and it will bring them renown on the day I display My glory, declares the Lord GOD.
translations.kjv: Yea, all the people of the land shall bury them; and it shall be to them a renown the day that I shall be glorified, saith the Lord GOD.
translations.asv: Yea, all the people of the land shall bury them; and it shall be to them a renown in the day that I shall be glorified, saith the Lord Jehovah.
